payload.reason: The evidence suggests that differences in solar radiation absorption due to valley orientation and humidity levels can influence glacier distribution in the Elwha and Quinault areas.

claims.text: The Elwha valley is expected to receive more solar radiation than the Quinault valley due to lower cloud cover, which can enhance glacier melt.
Spatial patterns in humidity and lapse rates between the Elwha and Quinault valleys may affect glacier mass balance and distribution.
Differences in melt efficiency between the Elwha and Quinault valleys could significantly influence glacier growth and distribution.
